name: doory-go
description: Faithful Go rewrite of the doory backend (PiG parity methodology). pnpm scripts are the build-target manager: the same gate ladder the PiG Makefile carries.

scripts.upstream-mirror: set -e; C=$(sed -n 's/.*UpstreamCommit = "\([0-9a-f]*\)".*/\1/p' internal/dooryversion/dooryversion.go); test -d .upstream/current || git clone https://github.com/shaongitbd/doory .upstream/current; git -C .upstream/current fetch --quiet origin; git -C .upstream/current checkout --quiet --detach "$C"; test -z "$(git -C .upstream/current status --porcelain)" || { echo 'mirror not pristine'; exit 1; }
scripts.oracle:setup: set -e; mkdir -p .oracle; uv venv .oracle/venv --python python3.12 -q; uv pip install -q --python .oracle/venv/bin/python -r .upstream/current/backend/requirements-dev.txt; echo 'oracle: setup complete (.oracle/venv)'
scripts.check: ${GO:-go} build ./... && ${GO:-go} vet ./... && ${GO:-go} test ./... && pnpm run port-map-drift && pnpm run divergence-consistency && pnpm run lint-scenarios
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run parity-fast && echo 'TODO(M1): full parity + contracts' && exit 1

targets-help.upstream-mirror: Refresh .upstream/current to the pinned commit (pristine, detached)
targets-help.generate: Regenerate compiler-derived inventories (ledger JSONs + PORT_MAP skeleton)
targets-help.schemagen: Regenerate migration DDL from the pinned oracle's SQLite database
targets-help.schema-parity: Schema-driver: digest-compare oracle vs Go, per dialect (sqlite always, PG when the docker lane runs)
targets-help.oracle:setup: Create .oracle/venv with the pinned backend deps (uv)
targets-help.oracle:serve: Boot the pinned Django oracle on 127.0.0.1:8012 (SQLite, test settings)
targets-help.oracle:probe: Probe the live oracle; save raw transcripts under test/parity/probes/
targets-help.check: Build, vet, lint, unit tests, drift gates, divergence guards, lint-scenarios
targets-help.parity-fast: Run scenarios tagged fast (one strict pair each)
targets-help.coverage: Regenerate the coverage report embedded in AGENTS.md (weak rows listed, never counted)
targets-help.port-map-drift: Reject unmapped Go sources and rows whose upstream file vanished
targets-help.lint-scenarios: Validate families.toml + scenario TOMLs against mirror and PORT_MAP
targets-help.divergence-consistency: Match DIVERGENCES records to call-site markers and the ID list
targets-help.frontend:build: Rebuild the embedded frontend (doory/webapp) from the pinned upstream source
targets-help.pg-smoke: Run the PostgreSQL smoke test against the local parity container (D4)
targets-help.build: Build the single binary (frontend embedded) into dist/doory for this platform
